use the appropriate machinery such as walk- behind spreader, liquid sprayers, and mix applicators for applying fertilizers
follow the appropriate soil-fertility improvement practices as per the gardener’s instructions
apply a variety of herbicides, weedicides, pesticides and insecticides as per the manufacturer’s instructions
maintain the record of fertilizers, herbicides, weedicides, pesticides and insecticides used in the garden
apply mulch on the garden soil to prevent weed growth
carry out intercropping to promote the growth of useful plants in the garden and suppress weed growth

conduct regular surveys in the garden and suggest improvements to the gardener

segregate waste into appropriate categories such as recyclable and non-recyclable
